operations.summary: Download a plugin licence for this installation (forwarded to the market)
operations.description: A live licence this installation holds is returned; a free plan issues the installation's free licence (repeat calls return the same one); otherwise the market answers 402 purchase_required. Naturally idempotent, so no Idempotency-Key is required. Market errors other than 401 and 5xx are passed through.

responses.description: Market error passed through (e.g. purchase_required, not_found)

operations.summary: What this controller holds of each market plugin (installed, enabled, withdrawn)
operations.description: Installed means an installation head exists in any tenant; enabled that one is enabled; withdrawn that a materialized artifact (data pack, ui_page, provider) was withdrawn by the platform because the licence moved to another controller or ended. No query parameters are accepted.

responses.description: One item per plugin with local state
